testResults.name: specification-coverage-review
testResults.command: manual review of .github/architecture/thesis-ui-design.md against AC1-AC4 and the eight product requirements
testResults.result: AC1: workspace creation/selection (switcher + create dialog), multiple chats and investigations (typed threads with hypothesis/falsification trails), uploads (untrusted evidence with provenance), workflow timelines (durable event stream with cursor state), steering (message-based with percolation ack), CLEO plan visibility (read-only plan/task projection), evidence (digest/revision-cited badges), strategy lineage (ancestry + exposure history), knowledge search (trust-tiered corpus with citations), activation consent (structured T172 confirmation inline) — all specified. AC2: SSE cursor/Last-Event-ID resume, ephemeral-frame dedup, content-addressed artifacts, bearer/Entra authorization, no second source of truth. AC3: implementation (Svelte per product decision, overriding the roadmap's React wording — documented in the decision record) deferred to the later UI task. AC4: all durable state remains in workspace repository/CLEO state served by the API; client state is view-only. The eight product requirements map to pages: workspace selection, workspace-as-home, workspace-scoped chat, backtest results with in-sample/out-of-sample split rendering (not-declared state when absent), deployment monitoring (P&L/orders/risk), workspace-authored widgets, screener with saved studies, train/test split

testResults.name: wave-integration-suite
testResults.result: 2368 passed, 14 skipped, 1 xfailed — spec-only change, suite unaffected

limitations: The two reference mockups are React (Next.js and Vite); their information architecture and visual design are adopted but their stack is not, per the product decision for Svelte
Widget sandboxing for custom programmatic widgets is specified as a constraint (workspace-artifact definitions, sandboxed rendering) with the concrete sandbox mechanism deferred to implementation
